text.arabic_uthmani: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍۢ فَخُورٍ

words.gloss_range: purposive linker fused into the negative purpose construction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negative purpose-particle chain tied to the prior ayah

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}) opens as the purposive edge of the fused {{ar:لِكَيْلَا}} ({{tr:likaylā}}) frame. It makes the following restraint over grief and exultation both the intended result and the explanation of the prior pre-inscription statement in 57:22, so the ayah begins in dependence rather than as an isolated maxim.

topics.headline: purpose fused into the opening particle chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah opens inside a compact purpose construction rather than with an independent maxim.
topics.reason: The particle is fused with the following purpose and negation material, and the clause evidence licenses the opening as the purpose continuation of the prior statement.

topics.headline: dependent opening tied to prior inscription
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emotional restraint is presented as the intended result of the prior pre-inscription disclosure.
topics.reason: The boundary and clause evidence identify the opening purpose frame as dependent on 57:22, so the word carries cross-ayah dependence, not a stand-alone preposition.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive purpose particle mediating between purpose and negation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negative purpose-particle chain tied to the prior ayah

words.prose: {{ar:كَيْ}} ({{tr:kay}}) supplies the subjunctive purpose control inside {{ar:لِكَيْلَا}} ({{tr:likaylā}}). The result is not a bare command to feel nothing; the grammar presents non-grief as the intended outcome of the prior disclosure, with {{ar:كَيْ}} ({{tr:kay}}) holding the middle between purpose and negation.

topics.headline: subjunctive purpose control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees non-grief as a desired purpose-state produced by the disclosure, not as a report that grief never occurs.
topics.reason: QAC and clause evidence place the following verb under a subjunctive purpose particle, preserving the CRITICAL claim about intentionality.

topics.headline: hinge between purpose and negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the three-particle chain orders the logic as purpose, mood-control, then negation.
topics.reason: The medial position of {{ar:كَيْ}} ({{tr:kay}}) inside the fused sequence supports its role as the hinge rather than an optional filler.

words.gloss_range: restrained grief over what has passed beyond reach; not every ordinary sadness
words.root_gloss_range: rare grief/consolation field, locally narrowed to a 2mp subjunctive imperfect of grief restrained under purpose

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired gain-side emotional verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَأْسَوْا}} ({{tr:taʾsaw}}) is a 2mp subjunctive imperfect under the purpose frame, so the addressed community is being kept from entering a grief-state. The rare {{ar:أ س و}} ({{tr:ʾ-s-w}}) register makes that grief feel like consuming sorrow over what cannot be controlled, while the local syntax narrows the point to restrained grief rather than a general ban on ordinary sadness; the same counsel-against-futile-grief field appears in 5:26, 5:68, and 7:93. As the first pole before {{ar:تَفْرَحُوا}} ({{tr:tafraḥū}}), it begins the ayah's balanced discipline of loss and gain, and the hamza catch inside the word gives that arrested grief a small audible break.

topics.headline: communal grief under purpose control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressed community being restrained from entering a grief-state, not being described after the fact.
topics.reason: The verb is 2mp imperfect subjunctive under the purpose particle; the plural ending makes the response communal.

topics.headline: rare grief register with wound-pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the restrained grief is a marked, consuming sorrow over loss, while the local prohibition does not cancel ordinary sadness.
topics.reason: The rare-root and grief/consolation rows survive as lexical pressure, but local syntax keeps the active sense on grieving rather than healing as a separate local action.

topics.headline: first pole of the loss-gain axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees grief paired with later exultation as the first half of a balanced emotional discipline.
topics.reason: The verb is coordinated with {{ar:تَفْرَحُوا}} ({{tr:tafraḥū}}) under the same purpose frame, and boundary evidence links the cosmic premise to human affect.

topics.headline: caught sound of grief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the small catch in the verb as a sound-level reinforcement of arrested grief.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows add a modest acoustic payoff and do not conflict with grammar or lexical evidence.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the object or ground over which grief settles

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: gain-side preposition contrasted with grief over loss

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) makes the missed thing the object over which grief settles. Its over/upon orientation remains visible, and it prepares the contrast with {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}), where gain becomes the ground in which exultation would occur.

topics.headline: grief rests over its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees grief grammatically directed over the missed thing rather than simply possessing it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following relative phrase the complement governed through {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), preserving the over/upon orientation.

topics.headline: loss over against gain in
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that loss and gain receive different spatial grammars: grief over loss, exultation in or by gain.
topics.reason: The contrast with {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is locally visible across the paired clauses.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun for whatever has escaped
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) forms the relative object of grief: what has escaped. By leaving the referent unnamed, it lets the loss-side include any missed outcome, and it sets up the mirrored gain-side {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) later in the ayah.

topics.headline: relative object of grief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the loss object formed as a compact relative clause, not as a question or negation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as a relative pronoun governed through {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}).

topics.headline: open slot for any loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse refuses to name one lost object, leaving the loss-slot open to whatever has escaped.
topics.reason: The open relative pronoun is mirrored later by the gain-side {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), supporting broad but locally controlled reference.

words.gloss_range: what has escaped or passed beyond the addressed group
words.root_gloss_range: passing beyond reach, missing, and gap imagery, locally narrowed to a perfect verb with the missed thing as subject and the addressees as object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: gain-side verb paired with what escaped

words.prose: {{ar:فَاتَكُمْ}} ({{tr:fātakum}}) casts the missed thing as what has already passed beyond reach, with the addressees carried in the suffix as the affected object. The {{ar:ف و ت}} ({{tr:f-w-t}}) gap imagery, visible through the disparity use in 67:3, can color the loss as an interval between reach and result, but the local verb remains escaped or missed. Its cadence and suffix mirror {{ar:ءَاتَىٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ātākum}}), making loss and gift audible as paired outcomes under the prior inscription of 57:22.

topics.headline: the escaped thing acts on you
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that loss is phrased as the missed thing passing beyond the addressees, not as the addressees owning or causing the loss.
topics.reason: The perfect Form I verb, subject analysis, and object suffix evidence support irreversible passing with the lost thing as grammatical mover.

topics.headline: gap-image behind missed outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel loss as a structural gap between reach and result, while the local sense remains escaped or missed.
topics.reason: The disparity branch is not the local lexical sense, but it validly narrows into image pressure behind what has passed beyond reach.

topics.headline: personal loss under prior inscription
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that what escaped is directly tied to the addressed group and grounded by the prior written-register premise.
topics.reason: The suffix is licensed as the object pronoun, and boundary evidence ties the loss phrase back to the pre-inscribed event domain of 57:22.

topics.headline: loss verb mirrored by gift verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the loss verb paired with the later gift verb, making escaped and given outcomes two halves of one event system.
topics.reason: The local pair with {{ar:ءَاتَىٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ātākum}}) is supported by co-occurrence, cadence, and the matched suffix structure.

words.gloss_range: coordinating hinge from the loss clause to the gain clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) coordinates the second prohibition with the first, so grief and exultation become opposed poles inside one purpose frame. It also marks the hinge where the ayah moves from what escaped to what was given.

topics.headline: coordination of opposed emotions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees grief and exultation joined as two poles of one response discipline.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses {{ar:تَفْرَحُوا}} ({{tr:tafraḥū}}) as coordinated with {{ar:تَأْسَوْا}} ({{tr:taʾsaw}}) under the same purpose construction.

topics.headline: hinge from loss to gain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact midpoint where the ayah turns from what escaped to what was given.
topics.reason: The conjunction visibly separates the loss-clause from the gain-clause while keeping them in one syntax.

words.gloss_range: independent negator extending the purpose restraint to the second verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: verb governed by the second negation
opening fused negative purpose frame

words.prose: The second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) stands free before {{ar:تَفْرَحُوا}} ({{tr:tafraḥū}}), extending the negative purpose frame into the gain clause. Because it is not fused inside {{ar:لِكَيْلَا}} ({{tr:likaylā}}), it gives the second prohibition its own surface while echoing the opening negation; the excluded response is acquisition-exultation, not happiness as such.

topics.headline: negation carried into the gain clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the negative purpose frame extend economically to the second emotional verb.
topics.reason: The free {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) stands before the coordinated verb and carries negative force across the gain clause.

topics.headline: free negation distinct from fused negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated negator is both a structural echo and a fresh surface prohibition against exultation.
topics.reason: The second particle mirrors the fused negation in the opening while remaining independent before {{ar:تَفْرَحُوا}} ({{tr:tafraḥū}}).

words.gloss_range: exultant joy over gain restrained under the same purpose frame
words.root_gloss_range: joy and exultation field, locally narrowed to excessive gain-response rather than every form of gladness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition mediating exultation over gain
paired grief-side emotional verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَفْرَحُوا}} ({{tr:tafraḥū}}) is the gain-side emotional verb under the same purpose restraint as {{ar:تَأْسَوْا}} ({{tr:taʾsaw}}). Its object is mediated by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}), so the target is exultation over what has been given, not every kind of gladness. In the ayah's movement, this inner excess anticipates the public boasting named at the close, recalls the worldly boasting of 57:20, and sits near the formulaic pairing of exultation with universal quantification.

topics.headline: second emotion under the same purpose restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exultation restrained at the level of response before it hardens into identity.
topics.reason: The verb is a 2mp imperfect under the extended purpose frame and remains a response verb rather than an adjective of identity.

topics.headline: joy narrowed to exultation over gain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah targets boast-prone exultation over received benefit, not every permissible gladness.
topics.reason: The following {{ar:بِمَا ءَاتَىٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:bimā ātākum}}) licenses gain-response scope; broader joy semantics are narrowed by negation and context.

topics.headline: exultation paired with grief and boasting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the inner joy-response as the gain-side counterpart to grief and as the seed of the later boasting diagnosis.
topics.reason: The rows converge on the paired shape with {{ar:تَأْسَوْا}} ({{tr:taʾsaw}}), the loss/gain opposition, same-surah pride language in 57:20, and the final vice coda.

topics.headline: sound bridge from exultation to boasting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear excess joy carried forward toward the final boast-word through sound and cadence.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows provide a local acoustic payoff without overriding the grammatical and lexical analysis.

words.gloss_range: causal or sphere-marking preposition for the ground of exultation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fused preposition and relative pronoun opening the gain object
grief-side preposition contrasted with gain-side bi

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) makes the received thing the ground or sphere of exultation. It fuses with the following relative pronoun in {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bimā}}), and it balances {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}): grief is over loss, while exultation is by or in gain.

topics.headline: given thing as ground of exultation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gain as the cause or sphere of exultation, not as an owned direct object of the verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) govern the gain-side relative phrase as complement of {{ar:تَفْرَحُوا}} ({{tr:tafraḥū}}).

topics.headline: prepositional balance with the grief clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah balances loss and gain through different prepositions rather than through identical syntax alone.
topics.reason: The contrast with {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is locally visible and supported by the paired clauses.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun for whatever has been given
words.prose: The second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) forms the gain-side relative clause: what was given. It mirrors the earlier {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), keeping both what escaped and what arrived open-ended rather than tying the emotional discipline to one named kind of event.

topics.headline: gain-side relative pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the given object framed by a relative clause parallel to the loss-side object.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence license {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as the relative pronoun supplying the thing given.

topics.headline: open mirror for every received gain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both escaped and given outcomes remain open-ended, so the restraint applies across the whole field of loss and gain.
topics.reason: The second relative pronoun repeats the first with a changed verb, creating a local syntactic echo that keeps both outcome classes unspecified.

words.gloss_range: what God has caused to reach the addressed group as a delivered gift
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arrival, and giving range, locally narrowed to Form IV causative bestowal with recipient suffix

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: loss-side verb mirrored by the giving verb

words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتَىٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ātākum}}) is the gain-side counterpart to {{ar:فَاتَكُمْ}} ({{tr:fātakum}}): what has been caused to arrive to you. The Form IV surface keeps divine bestowal in view, with the recipient suffix marking the addressed group; accepted form contrast sharpens the agency question but does not displace the local causative reading. Its near-mirror sound with {{ar:فَاتَكُمْ}} ({{tr:fātakum}}) turns escaped and delivered outcomes into a matched pair.

topics.headline: God-caused arrival to the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees gain as delivered bestowal toward the addressed group, not as autonomous acquisition.
topics.reason: The surface Form IV, implied 3ms subject, object suffix, and gift object together support causative arrival or giving with God as giver.

topics.headline: accepted reading contrast around agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant form evidence sharpens the agency question while the local surface keeps causative divine bestowal.
topics.reason: The Form I contrast is valid apparatus, but it does not replace the local Form IV parse of {{ar:ءَاتَىٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ātākum}}).

topics.headline: given gain as emotional test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gift verb as the trigger whose emotional response is being restrained under the prior divine event-domain.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence with joy language and boundary evidence connect giving to the restrained response and to the prior pre-inscription/origination frame.

topics.headline: sound-shifted mirror of what escaped
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the gain verb answer the loss verb with near-identical cadence but reversed event direction.
topics.reason: The phonetic and same-surah recurrence rows make the reversal audible without changing the local giving sense.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening the declarative coda
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) before the divine name is resumptive: it opens the declarative coda rather than adding another prohibition. The conjunction keeps the coda connected to the two emotional restraints while carrying the person-shift from addressed you to a statement about God.

topics.headline: resumptive turn to declarative coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the discourse pivot from addressed prohibitions into a statement about God.
topics.reason: Clause evidence identifies the following unit as a new declarative coda, not a third coordinated prohibition.

topics.headline: link that absorbs a person-shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small connector carries the shift from second-person address to third-person divine evaluation.
topics.reason: The particle fuses to the divine-name onset and connects the coda to the preceding command-pair.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as subject of the closing evaluation
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, refuge, and proper-name definiteness, locally fixed as the unique divine subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final paired vice expression

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) heads the closing coda as the proper divine subject. That placement grounds the emotional restraints in divine evaluation, not abstract sentiment. The proper name also stands over against the inflated self-image of {{ar:مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:mukhtālin fakhūrin}}), while the recurring God-love formula makes the ending a recognizable Quranic evaluative frame.

topics.headline: proper divine subject of the coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final evaluation anchored in the named divine subject, not in an abstract moral principle.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the proper divine name as the subject of the nominal/declarative coda.

topics.headline: divine name against inflated self-image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between the true divine subject and the self-magnifying posture named at the end.
topics.reason: The derivational and worship/refuge fields survive as theological pressure, but the local word is the proper name, not a new claim about etymology.

topics.headline: divine name inside recurring love formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the coda as part of a recurring divine love and non-love formula specialized here against arrogance.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and same-surah rows support the divine-name thread, the love formula, and the universal-promise versus universal-exclusion contrast in 57:10 and 57:23.

words.gloss_range: declarative negation over divine love for the whole vice class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: full universal object phrase under negated love
love verb negated by the particle

words.prose: The final {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is declarative, not another command. It negates {{ar:يُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:yuḥibbu}}) across the whole object phrase {{ar:كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:kulla mukhtālin fakhūrin}}), turning the paired emotional restraints into a standing divine verdict. As the third negation, it completes the ayah's movement from purpose-negation to prohibition to non-love.

topics.headline: declarative non-love over the full object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine love negated for the entire described vice class as an ongoing evaluation.
topics.reason: The particle negates the imperfect verb and scopes across {{ar:كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:kulla mukhtālin fakhūrin}}).

topics.headline: third negation completes the ayah architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices negation moving from purpose, to prohibition, to divine verdict.
topics.reason: The recurrence of {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) across the ayah binds the opening purpose, the second prohibition, and the final non-love declaration.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine love or approval negated for the described class
words.root_gloss_range: love, approval, attachment, and seed imagery, locally narrowed to Form IV divine evaluative love under negation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: self-deluded vice noun targeted by the non-love formula

words.prose: {{ar:يُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:yuḥibbu}}) is an imperfect divine love verb under negation, so the coda states continuing non-approval of the described class. The {{ar:ح ب ب}} ({{tr:ḥ-b-b}}) seed and attachment field can color love as generative attachment, but the local force is evaluative divine love denied. In formulaic use with {{ar:مُخْتَالٍ}} ({{tr:mukhtālin}}) in 31:18 and 4:36, the verb turns the ayah's emotional discipline into a character judgment.

topics.headline: ongoing divine approval denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the coda deny continuing divine approval, not merely report a passing dislike.
topics.reason: The imperfect under negation, direct object relation, and Form IV love evidence support ongoing divine evaluative non-love.

topics.headline: love as generative attachment denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel denied love as denied generative attachment, while the local sense remains divine approval or love.
topics.reason: The seed branch is not the local gloss of the verb, but it survives as root-image pressure for attachment and preciousness.

topics.headline: love formula converts emotion into character judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the preceding emotional excesses gathered into a universal character class under a recurring non-love formula.
topics.reason: The love/non-love formula and links with {{ar:مُخْتَالٍ}} ({{tr:mukhtālin}}) in 31:18 and 4:36 show that the coda generalizes the addressed restraints into character evaluation.

words.gloss_range: universal distributive object inside the non-love predicate
words.root_gloss_range: totality and related root branches, locally narrowed to exhaustive inclusion over an indefinite vice class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite vice noun governed by the quantifier

words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) is the accusative quantifier inside the non-love predicate, in construct with {{ar:مُخْتَالٍ}} ({{tr:mukhtālin}}). It distributes the verdict over every member of the vice class, leaving no exception inside that type. The broader {{ar:ك ل ل}} ({{tr:k-l-l}}) dullness branch is only narrowed image pressure here, letting the class feel morally blunted even as it is exhaustively counted; the local sense is exhaustive totality, sharpened by the same-surah reversal from universal promise in 57:10 to universal exclusion in 57:23 and by the clipped doubled-lām sound.

topics.headline: every member of the vice class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the non-love predicate distributed over every instance of the arrogant-boasting type.
topics.reason: The accusative quantifier is object of {{ar:يُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:yuḥibbu}}) and construct head before the indefinite vice noun, licensing exhaustive distributive scope.

topics.headline: bluntness image beside totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may sense moral diminishment around the exhaustive class, while the local selected sense remains totality.
topics.reason: The bluntness branch belongs to the root field but is not the operative local meaning of {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}); it survives only as narrowed image pressure.

topics.headline: universal promise reversed into universal exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same-surah movement from universal promise in 57:10 to universal exclusion of arrogance in 57:23.
topics.reason: The same-surah echo with 57:10 and the compressed sound of the doubled consonant give the totalizing word local rhetorical force.

words.gloss_range: self-imagining arrogance as the class noun under the universal quantifier
words.root_gloss_range: imagination, prestige, horse/cavalry, phantom, and conceit field, locally narrowed to a Form VIII participial vice term

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: boastful partner in the final vice pair
universal quantifier governing the vice noun

words.prose: {{ar:مُخْتَالٍ}} ({{tr:mukhtālin}}) supplies the indefinite class under {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}). The {{ar:خ ي ل}} ({{tr:kh-y-l}}) field of prestige, horse imagery, and phantoms is narrowed into psychological pressure: arrogance as self-generated unreality, not a literal horse or phantom sense. Its Form VIII shape makes the self-imagining reflexive, and its fixed pairing with {{ar:فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:fakhūrin}}) in 4:36, 31:18, and 57:23 turns inward delusion into the first half of a repeated vice formula.

topics.headline: class noun under the universal quantifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the target as a type distributed by the quantifier, not a named individual.
topics.reason: The genitive indefinite participle is the complement of {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}), with {{ar:فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:fakhūrin}}) agreeing as its descriptive partner.

topics.headline: prestige and phantom imagery behind conceit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that arrogance is pictured as self-important unreality drawing on prestige and phantom-image fields, while the local sense remains conceit.
topics.reason: The horse/cavalry and phantom branches are not separate active local senses, but they validly color the psychological derivative as imagined greatness.

topics.headline: Form VIII self-generated image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees arrogance as something the person participates in producing inwardly before it appears outwardly.
topics.reason: The Form VIII participial morphology and order before {{ar:فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:fakhūrin}}) support inward self-imagining that moves outward.

topics.headline: fixed vice-pair in divine non-love formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the word as part of a repeated pair where inward self-delusion and outward boasting are inseparable.
topics.reason: The occurrences in 4:36, 31:18, and 57:23 pair {{ar:مُخْتَال}} ({{tr:mukhtāl}}) with {{ar:فَخُور}} ({{tr:fakhūr}}), and local agreement binds the two descriptors.

words.gloss_range: habitual boastfulness qualifying the self-imagined arrogant type
words.root_gloss_range: boasting, vainglory, rivalry, and hollow-sounding clay imagery, locally narrowed to an intensive adjective in the fixed vice pair

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final paired vice expression

words.prose: {{ar:فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:fakhūrin}}) closes the ayah as the outward half of {{ar:مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:mukhtālin fakhūrin}}). Agreement makes boasting a qualifier of the self-deluded type, and the faʿūl pattern makes it habitual and intensive rather than momentary, with the wider boasting field carrying public rivalry and morally charged self-praise. The {{ar:ف خ ر}} ({{tr:f-kh-r}}) hollow-clay image is narrowed to color, but it helps the final word sound like loud empty self-display; as the last word, it turns excessive joy and self-imagining into public broadcast, with same-surah pride language from 57:20 behind it and the opening negative purpose returning as a negated character verdict.

topics.headline: boasting locked to self-delusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees boasting as the outward face of the same character type, not as a separate object.
topics.reason: Genitive agreement and repeated collocation bind {{ar:فَخُورٍ}} ({{tr:fakhūrin}}) to {{ar:مُخْتَالٍ}} ({{tr:mukhtālin}}) inside the universal object phrase.

topics.headline: hollow-sounding root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the final boast as loud and hollow, while the local sense remains boastful self-display.
topics.reason: The pottery branch is not the local lexical sense, but it survives as root-image pressure for hollow loudness.

topics.headline: habitual public self-praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word names a durable public vice, not a single moment of confidence.
topics.reason: The faʿūl pattern, rare distribution, and semantic rows support habitual or intensive boasting with moral charge.

topics.headline: final closure word of the arrogance circuit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah land on outward broadcast: loss and gain responses culminate in a diagnosable boastful character.
topics.reason: Closure position, same-surah 57:20 pride echo, sound links with {{ar:تَفْرَحُوا}} ({{tr:tafraḥū}}), and boundary agency all support the final diagnostic payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel prohibitions in 'do not grieve over what escaped you' and 'do not rejoice over what was given to you.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Loss and receipt are paired with their ordinary opposite affects, so the focus-only construction initially sounds like a symmetrical reduction of emotional amplitude.

activation_trace.role: Grief and consolation over what has passed supply the negative affective pole.
Failure to reach or recover something defines the loss that normally feeds grief.
Expansion of the breast and gladness supply the positive affective pole.
Giving identifies the received event that normally feeds joy.

changed_reading.before: Loss naturally calls for grief and receipt naturally calls for joy.
changed_reading.after: The focus alone can initially be heard as flattening both reactions in equal measure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast between what escaped the addressees and what was given to them, followed by condemnation of boasting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verbs portray goods as either beyond reach or delivered from elsewhere. Pride converts delivery into self-authorship, while grief can convert non-arrival into a claim that the missed thing should have been one's own.

activation_trace.role: Acting ahead without authorization supplies an exploratory image of the agency the disappointed self presumes.
The received good is explicitly an act of giving rather than evidence of self-production.
Boasting recites achievements and turns a received good into personal rank.

changed_reading.before: I failed to secure one thing but earned the thing now in my hand.
changed_reading.after: Neither missed nor received goods establish self-authorship; grief and boasting can be twin claims of ownership.

baseline_models.mechanism: Conceit begins as a projected image of the self, becomes visible in bearing, and culminates in narrated comparison with others. The two closing terms therefore describe a process rather than merely repeat one vice.

activation_trace.role: A likeness or image formed in the heart supplies the inwardly projected self.
Conceit displayed in one's gait turns the inward image into public bearing.
Competitive recital of exploits gives the projected image a social voice.
Prevailing over another in a boasting contest makes comparison the mechanism's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The ending supplies two near-synonyms for arrogance.
changed_reading.after: Fortune can be processed into an imagined identity, displayed bodily, and broadcast as superiority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of 'ta'saw' carries grief alongside treatment, repair, and mutual consolation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root inventory that names sorrow also opens practical repair and sharing. Negating grief may redirect energy from a self-enclosed wound toward mending and solidarity rather than demand indifference.

activation_trace.role: Treating and stitching a wound supplies a practical alternative to remaining inside pain.
Repair between people and sharing self or wealth turns loss outward into mutual support.
Actual grief over the missed thing remains the literal state being redirected.

changed_reading.after: It may also refuse grief's self-enclosure so that loss can be met by repair and mutual consolation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine ownership, commanded outflow, human succession, and final inheritance turn received goods into temporary custody. This strengthens the focus-only suspicion that both grief and boasting mistake a passing assignment for personal title.

activation_trace.role: The focus names the possession as something given into the addressees' hands.
What passes beyond reach marks the other end of temporary possession.
Ownership with power of disposal locates ultimate title outside the human recipient.
The commanded exit of wealth makes circulation, not retention, the expected use of custody.
One party following another and standing in its place supplies the temporary-successor relation.
Inheritance transfers what one holder leaves to another and closes the custody cycle.

structural_cues: 57:2 and 57:5 repeat divine dominion; 57:7 then commands spending from what people were made successors in, and 57:10 names the inheritance of heavens and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership, expenditure, succession, and inheritance; I infer that their sequence makes human possession custodial. A live alternative is that each statement functions independently without specifying a single property regime.

changed_reading.before: Emotional restraint concerns private reactions to one's possessions.
changed_reading.after: The restraint trains a custodian: receipt is an assignment to circulate, and loss is the end of an assignment rather than dispossession from absolute title.

context_deltas.mechanism: Doubt, heart-fashioned wishes, and repeated deception provide the content from which the focus's imagined self is built. Boasting then stabilizes a fragile projection by making other people hear and recognize it.

activation_trace.role: Imagination, suspicion, and mistaken resemblance anchor conceit in uncertain perception.
Public recital converts the uncertain image into a claimed social fact.
Agitated doubt supplies the instability beneath the self-projection.
A deceptive gleam that does not endure supplies the mechanism by which appearance is mistaken for durable standing.
A wish pictured by the heart supplies imagined future confirmation of the projected self.

structural_cues: 57:14 chains self-testing, waiting, doubt, wishes, and deception until an arriving command breaks the projection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unstable doubt, picturing wishes, and deceptive appearance; I infer that these feed the focus's self-image and that boasting socially props it up. The alternative is that 57:14 concerns eschatological delay rather than the psychology of fortune.

changed_reading.before: Conceit is confidence inflated by actual success.
changed_reading.after: Conceit may be compensatory: unstable wishes and appearances are assembled into a self-image, then announced as success.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby contrast between a humbled heart and a hardened one, followed by dead earth revived, revises the initial affect-flattening model. The aim is a responsive heart no longer captured by possession, not a heart made inert to pain or joy.

activation_trace.role: Real sorrow remains present, so the revised model must explain regulation without denying feeling.
Real gladness remains the positive response whose possessive excess is being limited.
Lowering and yielding describe a living responsiveness rather than emotional absence.
Loss of the heart's softness names the failed condition that mere numbness would reproduce.
Earth made alive by rain and vegetation supplies the image of renewed receptivity.
Departure of force and life marks inertness as the state from which revival moves away.

structural_cues: 57:16 asks for humbled hearts and warns against hardening; 57:17 immediately commands attention to revival after death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies humility versus hardness and life after death; I infer that the affective pair in 57:23 protects responsiveness by removing possessive fixation. A live alternative is a stricter ascetic suppression of both emotions.

changed_reading.before: The verse seeks emotional flatness toward both loss and gain.
changed_reading.after: It seeks a soft, revivable heart whose sorrow and delight do not harden into possessive fixation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context lays out a causal sequence: adornment becomes mutual boasting, boasting recruits numerical rivalry, attractive growth is mistaken for durable value, and the growth dries into fragments. The focus's restraint at the moment of receipt interrupts that cycle before a gift becomes comparative identity.

activation_trace.role: Joy inflated into insolent exultation is the affective hinge from receiving to rivalry.
Conceit displayed in bearing shows the received good becoming visible status.
Mutual recital of achievements places the focus's final vice inside an explicit social sequence.
Trying to prevail by number turns boast into accumulation of wealth and children.
Life-giving rain begins an attractive but temporary growth cycle.
Vegetation emerging from earth materializes the apparent increase that draws admiration.
Yellowing and drying reverse apparent increase into decline.
Dry matter breaking into fragments gives the rivalry cycle its material endpoint.
Unstable glitter explains why transient increase is misread as lasting rank.

structural_cues: 57:20 orders play, distraction, adornment, mutual boasting, numerical rivalry, admired growth, yellowing, and fragmentation; 57:23 then names exultation, conceit, and boasting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered social and vegetal sequence; I infer that exultation over receipt is an upstream conversion point into rivalry. The alternative is that 57:20 offers only a general transience analogy without tracing individual affect into social competition.

changed_reading.before: Boasting is a bad reaction after good fortune.
changed_reading.after: Possessive exultation is the switch by which a gift enters a rivalry-and-decay cycle; the prohibition interrupts the cycle at entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated statements that grace is a benefaction in God's hand and is given according to another will make receipt a poor measure of personal merit. The focus's anti-boasting clause blocks the inference from 'given to me' to 'proof of my superiority.'

activation_trace.role: The focus anchors the model in receipt as giving.
Comparative victory in boasting is the false merit conclusion drawn from receipt.
Benefaction and gift name the source category of what is distributed.
Giving to whomever is willed explicitly detaches allocation from recipient self-authorship.
Capacity that enables action and possession is denied to the would-be controllers of grace.
The repeated benefaction remains the distributed good rather than a badge generated by its recipient.
The owning hand places control of grace with the giver.
The repeated act of giving closes the surah with the same allocation logic as the focus.

structural_cues: 57:21 and 57:29 repeat that divine grace is given to whomever is willed; 57:29 also echoes the focus's purpose construction with another 'so that not' clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies benefaction, an owning hand, denied human capacity, and repeated giving; I infer that allocation cannot function as a merit score. A live alternative is that grace can correlate with merit while still remaining divinely controlled.

changed_reading.before: The verse warns against over-celebrating a deserved success.
changed_reading.after: Receipt is not a merit signal at all: the gift points to the giver's freedom, so converting it into comparative status is a category error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding statement places every striking event in an inscription before its creation, and the focus opens as its purpose. This changes symmetrical emotional advice into an epistemic consequence: prior inscription removes both retrospective self-blame and triumphal self-credit.

activation_trace.role: The inaccessible missed event is the object of retrospective grief.
The delivered event is the object of triumphal self-credit.
An occurrence that strikes a person supplies the event whose authorship is being reclassified.
An inscription that establishes decree locates the event in an order prior to human reaction.
Temporal precedence makes the inscription antecedent rather than a later explanation.
Creation supplies the temporal threshold before which the event is already inscribed.

structural_cues: 57:23 begins with a purpose marker and directly follows 57:22's statement of inscription before creation; its two affective clauses therefore state a result of that knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies event, inscription, precedence, creation, and an adjacent purpose clause; I infer a de-authorizing arrow from prior inscription to reduced self-blame and self-credit. The alternative is that inscription supplies consolation without addressing causal authorship.

changed_reading.before: Do not indulge grief or exuberance because emotional moderation is virtuous.
changed_reading.after: Learn the prior order of events so neither the missed outcome nor the received one can be turned into a total verdict about one's own authorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah moves from the boastful figure to withholding, commanding others to withhold, turning away, and divine self-sufficiency. This makes boastful joy socially productive of scarcity: a recipient treats the gift as proof of self-sufficiency, hoards it, and exports hoarding as a norm.

activation_trace.role: A thing given to the recipient is the resource whose social handling is at issue.
Insolent exultation converts receipt into entitlement.
Boasting publicly turns private entitlement into a status claim.
Withholding supplies the concrete social behavior downstream of possessive exultation.
Demand and obligation show hoarding being propagated to other people as a rule.
Turning away marks withdrawal from the circulation and relation demanded by the gift.
True self-sufficiency belongs to God and exposes the recipient's performed independence as false.

structural_cues: 57:24 is the immediate continuation of the focus's closing description, but the exact grammatical attachment of 'those who withhold' remains open.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, withholding, norm-setting, turning away, and divine sufficiency; I infer a causal path from boastful receipt to hoarding. The materially live alternative is that 57:24 introduces a separate group rather than consequences of the figure in 57:23.

changed_reading.before: Boasting damages the boaster's private character.
changed_reading.after: Boasting over a gift can manufacture scarcity: it licenses retention, recruits others into retention, and imitates a self-sufficiency the recipient does not possess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The move from boastful withholding to scale, upright standing, equity, and a hard boundary suggests an inward-to-public mechanism. Fortune that distorts self-estimation also distorts how one weighs people; affective de-centering makes an equitable measure possible.

activation_trace.role: Distance, disparity, and defect in comparison supply the imbalance generated by fortune-based ranking.
A contest of self-presentation makes personal comparison the inward distortion to be corrected.
Winning a boasting contest supplies the false scale on which people are ranked.
A scale of justice supplies the public corrective to fortune-weighted comparison.
Straightness, balance, and evenness describe people standing without the tilt of self-exaltation.
Equity and fair dealing name the social relation produced by corrected measure.
A distinguishing boundary supplies firmness where fair measure must resist self-serving drift.

structural_cues: After 57:23-24 diagnose boast and withholding, 57:25 introduces scripture, scale, people's standing in equity, and iron.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false comparison in the focus and public scale, uprightness, equity, and boundary afterward; I infer that inner affective balance conditions public judgment. The alternative is that the justice apparatus is independent of the preceding affective diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks for private humility before changing fortune.
changed_reading.after: Private humility is also calibration for public justice: one must stop weighting persons by what reached or missed them before standing with an equitable scale.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the secondary debt-and-deposit branch of joy rather than its ordinary gladness sense. It remains anchored in the focus's received good and is reinforced by the context's loan, multiplication, and carried share; downstream prose should present it as an accountability analogy, not as a lexical replacement for 'rejoice.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The thing given in 57:23 and the debt-or-deposit burden available within the root inventory of 'rejoice.'

activation_trace.role: Being burdened by debt or deposits makes a received good carry obligation rather than only delight.
Giving supplies the entrusted item whose receipt can create responsibility.
Cutting out wealth or action for a returned recompense supplies a loan-like circulation of value.
Increase by another like amount makes return, not static possession, the endpoint of value.
A carried or prepared share reinforces receipt as an allotment borne by its recipient.

changed_reading.before: What is given is a pure windfall inviting pleasure.
changed_reading.after: What is given may be carried like an entrusted share: joy without accountability misreads a deposit as disposable status.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the rain-cloud image belongs to the root inventory of 'mukhtal' but is not its direct adjectival gloss here. It remains anchored by that focus root and by 57:20's rain-to-dryness sequence; downstream prose should qualify it explicitly as a material analogy for conceit, not translate 'mukhtal' as cloud.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rain-cloud promise and mistaken appearance branches of the root خ ي ل in 'mukhtal.'

activation_trace.role: A cloud that promises rain supplies an appearance of future abundance before yield is secure.
Imagination and mistaken resemblance explain appropriation of promise as accomplished status.
Actual rain begins the growth image whose promise the conceited self appropriates.
Emergent vegetation is the visible success mistaken for settled personal rank.
Drying and yellowing expose the promise as temporary and undo the imagined permanence.

changed_reading.before: The conceited person boasts after abundance is securely possessed.
changed_reading.after: Conceit can appropriate even a cloud's promise and early growth as already-earned status, before the transient yield has survived.

strongest_changes: The adjacent prior-inscription clause changes generic emotional moderation into a de-authoring consequence of how events are known.
Divine ownership, succession, spending, and inheritance turn possession into temporary custody and required circulation.
The growth-and-decay sequence makes possessive exultation an upstream switch into boasting, accumulation, and deceptive comparison.
The humbled-versus-hardened heart revises emotional zeroing: the target is responsive non-possession, not numbness.
The following withholding and scale passages extend private fortune-response into social scarcity and public justice.
summary.what_was_special: The focus joins a tight causal hinge: what is inscribed and given must not become self-authorship; otherwise an imagined self converts temporary custody into rivalry, hoarding, and a tilted social measure. Secondary branches also preserved two unusual material readings, the received good as a carried deposit and conceit as appropriation of a rain-cloud's promise.
remaining_uncertainties: The parallel prohibitions still permit a stricter affect-suppression reading even though the humbled and revived heart favors regulated responsiveness.
The grammatical relation of 57:24's withholders to 57:23's boastful figure controls how strongly the boast-to-hoarding mechanism can be asserted.
The wound-repair, debt-deposit, and rain-cloud activations are branch-supported analogies but should not displace the ordinary lexical senses.
The inward-balance-to-public-justice arrow is coherent from sequence and branch images but remains reader-supplied rather than grammatically explicit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Prior measure turns grief toward consolation rather than possession.** ء س و B004 is grief and consolation, and B002 reconciliation and shared support; ف و ت B001 is missing or being beyond reach. The purpose particle attaches this emotional result to 57:22. The packet supplies loss + prior inscription; I infer what was never finally possessed can be grieved without the self collapsing around it. **لا تأسوا** reads as re-forming grief, not denying pain.
2. **Joy splits into expansion or arrogant overflow.** ف ر ح B001 is glad expansion of the chest, while B002 is exultant arrogance. The negation is followed by **مختال فخور**, activating the second branch. The packet supplies receipt then boastful self-display; I infer received good treated as self-produced -> expansion hardens into superiority. The ayah restrains appropriative exultation rather than every glad response.
3. **Swagger begins as an imagined image of the self.** خ ي ل B001 is imagined or resembling image and B003 swaggering pride; ف خ ر B001 is boasting through inherited distinction. The packet supplies imagination before public boasting in the lexical range; I infer false self-image -> performed superiority. **مختال فخور** reads as an inward projection becoming social display.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:24 immediately gives this affective distortion an economic and social output: withholding and commanding others to withhold. 57:29 finally removes any ground for pride by locating فضل entirely with God.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Prior inscription functions as consolation and shared support.** `ء س و` **B004** supplies grief and consolation, while dormant **B002** supplies reconciling and supporting another with self or wealth. The purpose particle ties this ayah directly to the book-before-occurrence of 57:22; charitable relinquishment in 57:18 and light-giving mercy in 57:28 surround it. The packet supplies grief-control and communal support; I infer that accepting limited control frees value and attention for support rather than private fixation. “Do not grieve” therefore reads as socially productive consolation, not emotional numbness.
2. **Missed and granted things are symmetric evidence of non-control.** `ف و ت` **B001** supplies what passes beyond reach and **B004** the gap between things; `ء ت ي` **B002** supplies what is granted or brought. The exact negated parallel sets loss and receipt on either side of the same affective discipline. The packet supplies the symmetry; I infer that neither side warrants an ownership claim. What misses is not proof of abandonment, and what arrives is not proof of self-authorship.
3. **Exultation manufactures an imagined superior self.** `ف ر ح` **B002** supplies boastful exultation, `خ ي ل` **B001** an imagined image and **B003** swaggering pride, and `ف خ ر` **B002** a declaration of superiority. Competitive display in 57:20 precedes, miserliness in 57:24 follows, and the scale in 57:25 supplies an external measure. The packet supplies this sequence; I infer that attachment to a grant generates a self-image, which seeks public superiority and then withholds. The condemned joy is therefore a mechanism of fictive ownership, not gladness as such.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:24 immediately completed the inferred chain: imagined superiority becomes withholding and then recruits others. 57:25's balance supplied an external corrective to self-measure, while 57:28's granted shares confirmed that receipt remains gift rather than evidence of authorship.

baseline.text: Bunu, elinizden çıkana üzülmeyesiniz ve size verdiğine sevinmeyesiniz diye yaptık. Allah kendini beğenen, övüngen hiç kimseyi sevmez.

findings.text: Önceden belirlenmiş ölçüyü bilmek, kaybın acısını inkar etmeden yasın kişiyi sahiplik etrafında çökertmesini önleyen ve başkalarına desteğe açan bir teselliye dönüştürür.
Elden çıkan ile verilen şey, insanın denetiminde olmadığını iki karşı yönden gösterir; kayıp terk edilmişliğin, geliş de kişinin kendi başarısının kanıtı değildir.
Yasaklanan sevinç her türlü mutluluk değil, alınan nimeti kişinin kendi üretimi sayarak hayali bir üstün benlik ve ardından toplumsal övünme üreten taşkınlıktır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: failing to reach or retain `quranic:root_001183:B001/m01`; a gap through which something escapes `quranic:root_001183:B004/m01`; grief over what was missed `quranic:root_000034:B004/m01`; giving and received gift `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; joy `quranic:root_001140:B001/m01`; exultant joy `quranic:root_001140:B002/m01`; swaggering self-display `quranic:root_000454:B003/m01`; boasting by recounting advantage `quranic:root_001135:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Loss is pictured as something slipping beyond reach through an opening, while gain is explicitly something brought to the recipient. The prior inscription removes neither response, but prevents the two trajectories from expanding into consuming grief or boastful exultation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, bir yarayı ya da yaralı kişiyi ilaç, dikiş veya başka bir tıbbi müdahaleyle tedavi etmektir. Hekim, ilaç, tedavi edilmiş kişi ve kadın sünnetçisi için kullanılan örtmeceli ad aynı alana bağlı adlandırmalardır; bunlar tedavi eyleminin kurucu parçaları değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca bedensel yara tedavisini ve ona bağlı adlandırmaları kapsar; toplumsal uzlaştırma, örnek alma, keder ve yapı direği anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanım düzeyinde yara veya yaralı kişiyi tedavi etmeyi bildirir; türemiş kişi, ilaç ve hasta adları bu çekirdeğe bağlı kalır.

concept_map.definition: Bir yarayı ya da yaralı kişiyi ilaç, dikiş veya benzeri tıbbi müdahalelerle iyileştirmeye çalışmaktır. Bu alana tedaviyi yapan hekim, kullanılan ilaç ve tedavi edilen kişi için kullanılan bağlı adlar da girer.

facets.statement: Yara veya yaralı kişi üzerinde iyileştirici bir tedavi uygulanır.
Tedavi, hekimin ilaç ve dikiş kullanması gibi tıbbi işlemlerle gerçekleştirilebilir.
Hekim, ilaç, tedavi edilmiş yaralı ve kadın sünnetçisi için bu tedavi alanından türeyen adlandırmalar kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yara veya yaralı kişiyi tedavi etme çekirdeğinde birleşir; ilaç, dikiş, hekim ve tedavi sonucu ortaya çıkan kişi adları bu çekirdeğin çevresinde toplanır. Kadın sünnetçisi için kullanılan ad ise örtmeceli ve ikincil bir kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yara veya yaralı kişiye iyileştirici müdahale uygulama çekirdeğini en kısa biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yarayı iyileştirmek amacıyla uygulanan tedavi işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: yarayı ilaçla ve dikişle tedavi etmek
contextual_glosses.applicability: Hekimin kullandığı tedavi yöntemlerinin açıkça belirtildiği bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yaraya yönelik tıbbi müdahaleyi ve belirtilen iki yöntemi korur.
error_profile.loses: İlaç ve dikiş dışındaki tedavi yollarını ve bağlı adlandırmaları dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tedavinin yöntemi belirtilmeden eylemin amacı öne çıkarıldığında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaraya yönelik iyileştirici müdahalenin amaç ve süreç yönünü korur.

yaralanmış veya yarası tedavi edilmiş kişi

error_profile.loses: Bir kişinin yaraya uyguladığı tedavi eylemini siler.
error_profile.adds: Tedavi işlemi yerine hastanın kendiliğinden veya sonuç olarak iyileşmesini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir iyileştirme müdahalesidir; komşu dal ise yaranın düzelmesiyle ortaya çıkan durum ve sonuçtur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı fakat ayrı kullanım verir: insanların arasını düzeltmek ve bir kimseyi canıyla ya da malıyla kendine ortak ederek desteklemek. Karşılıklı destekleşme de ikinci kullanımın çoğul ve karşılıklı görünümüdür; bu nedenle dal tek bir genel 'iyilik etme' anlamına indirgenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzlaştırma yalnızca insanlar arasındaki ilişkiyi düzeltme yapısında, maddi veya kişisel destek ise paylaşma ve ortak etme yapısında geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, insanlar arasını düzeltmeye bağlı bir söz öbeğiyle, malı veya canı paylaşmaya bağlı destek yapısını ve karşılıklı destekleşme biçimini ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda, insanların bozulan arasını düzeltmek veya bir kimseyi malına ya da kişisel desteğine ortak ederek ona dayanışma göstermektir. Karşılıklı biçimi, kişilerin birbirini aynı yolla desteklemesini anlatır.

facets.statement: İnsanların arasındaki bozuk ilişki düzeltilip yeniden uyum sağlanır.
Bir kişi malını veya kişisel gücünü başkasıyla paylaşarak onu destekler.
Eylem karşılıklı olduğunda insanlar birbirlerini destekleyip dayanışırlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasını düzeltme kullanımıyla mal veya kişisel imkân paylaşarak destek olma kullanımını birlikte verir. Karşılıklı biçim, bu desteğin taraflarca birbirine yöneltilmesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın ilişkiyi düzeltme ve mal ya da kişisel imkânı paylaşma çekirdeklerini birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem insanlar arasını düzeltmeyi hem de paylaşma yoluyla destek olmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylem iki veya daha çok kişi arasındaki anlaşmazlığı giderme yapısında kullanıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bozulmuş toplumsal ilişkiyi düzeltme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Mal veya kişisel destek paylaşma ve karşılıklı dayanışma yönlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimse başkasını maddi imkânlarına veya kişisel desteğine ortak ettiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Paylaşma yoluyla kişisel veya maddi destek sunmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsanların arasını düzeltme ve desteğin karşılıklı olma yönlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Desteğin tek yönlü değil karşılıklı olarak verildiği çoğul bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tarafların karşılıklı dayanışmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Uzlaştırma kullanımını ve mal ya da can paylaşımının açık ayrıntısını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: malıyla veya canıyla destek olup paylaşmak

error_profile.preserves: Bir başkasına destek sağlama yönünü genel düzeyde korur.
error_profile.adds: Uzlaştırma veya malı ve kişisel gücü paylaşma koşulu bulunmayan her türlü yardımı kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Genel yardım alanıyla çakışarak dalın yapı ve katılımcı sınırlarını belirsizleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiyi veya onun içinde bulunduğu hâli izlenecek örnek saymayı ve o örneğe uymayı açıkça bir araya getirir. Kederli kişinin kendini avutmak için bir başkasını örnek alması bu genel örnek alma ilişkisinin özel bir bağlamıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, izlenecek örnek ile o örneğe uyma ilişkisini kapsar; sırf benzerlik, genel yöntem veya bağımsız keder anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, örnek veya örnek alınan durum bildiren ad kullanımını, belirli bir kişiye uyma yapısındaki eylem kullanımından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya onun içinde bulunduğu hâl, başkasının davranışını kendisine göre yönelttiği bir örnek olur; kişi de bu örneği izleyerek ona uyar. Keder bağlamında aynı ilişki, benzer durumu yaşamış birini örnek alıp teselli bulmaya yarayabilir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya durum, başkasınca izlenecek örnek kabul edilir.
Örnek alan kişi davranışını seçtiği kişiye veya duruma uydurur.
Kederli kişi benzer kaybı yaşamış birini örnek alarak kendini avutabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar izlenecek örnek, o örneğe uyma ve başkasının hâlini takip etme çekirdeğinde birleşir. Kederli kişinin teselli bulmak üzere bir örneğe yönelmesi, genel örnek alma ilişkisinin bağlama özgü uygulamasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İzlenecek örnek ile örnek alan kişinin davranışını ona uydurması arasındaki tam ilişkiyi karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem model işlevini hem de kişinin bu modele uymasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ad kullanımında izlenen kişinin ya da onun hâlinin model işlevi öne çıktığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişi veya durumun izlenecek model oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Örnek alan kişinin etkin biçimde ona uyma eylemini açıkça bildirmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylem kullanımında kişinin davranışını seçtiği modele uydurması anlatıldığında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Model seçme ve onun davranışına uyma ilişkisini birlikte korur.
İki kişi veya durum arasındaki benzerlik sonucunu çağrıştırabilir.

error_profile.adds: Örnek alma bulunmadan ortaya çıkan her türlü benzerliği kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Karşılıklı veya rastlantısal benzerlikle karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Önder, yönetici, ibadet yöneticisi, kitap, yol ve yapı kılavuzu gibi geniş öncülük kullanımlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişi başkalarınca izlenen örnek veya önder olduğunda iki alan kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal örnek alma ilişkisidir; komşu dal ise öne konan, yöneten veya yol gösteren varlığın görev ve konumunu adlandırır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: لي في فلان إسوة أي قدوة أقتدي به (maqayis); الاسم الأسوة والجمع الأسى (jamhara); الإسوة ما يأتسي به الحزين وائتسى به أي اقتدى (sihah); الأسوة والإسوة كالقدوة والقدوة وهي الحالة التي يكون الإنسان عليها في اتباع غيره (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kaybedilen şeyin ardından duyulan kederi, bir başkasını teselli etmeyi ve kişinin teselli bulmasını birlikte destekler. Sabrın aynı adla anılması kederin özdeş anlamı değil, kayıp karşısında dayanma yönündeki ikincil bir adlandırmadır; izlenecek örnek de yalnızca teselli sağladığı bağlamda bu dala girer.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kayıp kaynaklı keder ile bu kederi yatıştırma sürecini kapsar; genel örnek alma ve her tür üzüntü bu sınıra kendiliğinden girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, keder bildiren yalın biçimleri, bir kişi için üzülme yapısını ve birini teselli etme ya da teselli bulma biçimlerini ayrı kullanım katmanları olarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Kaybedilen veya geçmişte kalan bir şeyin ardından keder duymak ya da bu kederi yaşayan kişiyi teselli edip yatıştırmaktır. Kişinin benzer bir durumu örnek alarak kendini avutması ve kayba sabırla dayanması bu sürecin bağlı görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Kişi kaybedilen veya geçmişte kalan şeyin ardından keder duyar.
Bir başkası kederli kişiyi teselli ederek acısını yatıştırmaya çalışır.
Kederli kişi teselli bularak kendini avutur ve kayba sabırla dayanabilir.
Benzer kaybı yaşamış bir kişi veya durum, kederliye teselli sağlayan örnek olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kaybın ardından gelen keder ile birini teselli etme kullanımlarını birlikte verir. Teselli bulma, sabır gösterme ve benzer durumdaki birini örnek edinme, bu kederin yatışmasına bağlı yönlerdir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kayıptan doğan keder ile bu kederi yatıştırma yönlerini kısa ve dengeli biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kayıp kaynaklı kederi, teselli etmeyi ve teselli bulmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bir kayıp veya geçmişte kalan şey yüzünden duyduğu acı anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kederin kaybedilen şeye yönelmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Teselli etme, teselli bulma ve sabır gösterme yönlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin kederli bir başkasının acısını yatıştırmaya çalıştığı geçişli kullanımda doğaldır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir etkiyi veya kişiler arası eylemi bildirir; komşu dal bir kişi, iş, söz ya da niteliğe yönelik değerlendirme bildirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; seçilen karşılaştırmalar üzüntü ve kötü muamele çekirdeğini zarar, sakınca ve niteliksel kötülükten ayıran en yararlı sınırlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel bedensel kusur ve hastalık anlamını açıkça verir, ayrıca belirli bir söz diziminde beyaz lekeli deri hastalığını örtülü biçimde belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel hastalık çekirdeği ile belirli deri hastalığını anlatan kalıp ayrıdır; ahlaki kötülük veya birini üzme anlamı buraya taşınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim bedensel kusur veya hastalık alanını taşır; belirli deri hastalığının yokluğu yalnız kanıtta verilen söz kalıbına bağlı bir özelleşmedir.

concept_map.definition: Bedende bulunan bir kusur, bozukluk veya hastalıktır. Belirli bir kalıp içinde özellikle deride beyaz lekeler oluşturan hastalığın bulunmamasını örtülü biçimde anlatır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam bedensel kusurları, bozuklukları ve hastalıkları topluca kapsar.
Kanıtta verilen olumsuz kalıp, özellikle beyaz lekeli bir deri hastalığının bulunmadığını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar genel bedensel kusur ve hastalık anlamında birleşir; belirli olumsuz kullanımda bunun beyaz lekeli deri hastalığına yönelik örtülü bir anlatım olduğunu gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel ad olarak bedendeki kusur ve hastalıkları kapsar; belirli deri hastalığı okuması ayrıca bağlama bağlıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Genel bedensel kusur ile hastalık çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz konusu biçim genel olarak bedendeki hastalık ve kusurları topluca adlandırdığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hastalık ve bedensel kusur kapsamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kanıtta belirtilen olumsuz söz kalıbında, deride beyaz lekeler oluşturan hastalığın bulunmadığını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı hastalık türünü ve onun bulunmaması koşulunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: beyaz lekeli deri hastalığı veya başka bir bedensel kusur olmadan

error_profile.collision: Çirkinlik ve kötülük dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bedensel hastalık ve bozukluk alanında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal hastalığın bedeni tutmasını ve belirli belirtili halleri anlatır; bu dal kusur veya hastalığın kendisini genel ad olarak belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan bedenindeki kusur ve hastalıkları genel olarak kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: At ve katırlara özgü belirli bir hastalığı ve o hastalığa tutulmuş hayvanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal hastalık adlandırma alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal hayvan türü ve hastalık türü bakımından dar ve özeldir; bu dal genel bedensel kusur veya hastalık anlamındadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak odağı kadın veya erkeğin örtülmesi beklenen cinsel bölgesidir; ancak aynı ifade bir kaynakta her utanç verici iş veya durum için daha geniş bir kullanımı da içerir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal özel bölge çekirdeğiyle korunabilir, fakat utanç verici iş veya durum kullanımı bu çekirdeğin tanımı gibi değil, ayrı bir kaynak varyantı gibi belirtilmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin örtülmesi gereken özel bölge anlamına dayanır; herhangi bir kalıba bağlı anlam içe aktarılmaz ve daha geniş utanç verici iş kullanımı ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsan bedeninde örtülmesi beklenen cinsel bölgeyi, özellikle kadın veya erkeğin üreme organlarını anlatır. Kaynak ifadesindeki her utanç verici iş ya da durum kullanımı aynı biçimin ayrı ve daha geniş bir anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam kadın veya erkeğin örtülmesi beklenen cinsel bölgesi ve üreme organıdır.
Aynı biçim kaynak ifadesinde ayrıca her utanç verici iş veya durum için daha geniş anlamda kullanılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek kadın veya erkeğin örtülmesi beklenen cinsel bölgesidir; toplu kaynak ifadesi aynı biçimin utanç verici iş veya durum anlamında daha geniş bir kullanımını da kaydeder.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yalnız kadınla sınırlıdır; bu dal kadın ve erkeğin örtülmesi gereken cinsel bölgesini birlikte kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı bir kişinin yaptığı işi ayıplamak, kötü bulmak ve ona kötü yaptığını söylemek olarak doğrudan tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız kötü bir işin varlığını değil, o işi yapan kişiye yöneltilen ayıplama ve kınama eylemini gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylem adı ayıplama ve kötülemeyi bildirir; kişi ve yaptığı iş arasındaki yönelim ise kanıtta verilen söz kalıbına bağlı olarak açıkça korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yaptığı işi ayıplayıp kötülemek ve ona yaptığı şeyin kötü olduğunu söylemektir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, birinin yaptığı işi kusurlu veya kötü bularak o kişiye yöneltilen ayıplama eylemidir.
Ayıplama, kişiye yaptığı işin kötü olduğunu açıkça söylemeyi de içerir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin yaptığı iş hedef alınarak kusurlu bulunuyor ve bu yargı kendisine yöneltiliyorsa dalın tam çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılan işi hedef alma, ayıplama ve kişiye yöneltme öğelerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayıplamanın kişiye doğrudan bildirilmesi ve yaptığı işin kötü olduğunun söylenmesi öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kötüleme yargısının eylemi yapan kişiye sözle yöneltilmesini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin kişinin önüne geçmesi veya ondan uzaklaşması yüzünden onu kavrayıp ona ulaşamamasını ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Başkasının bu kaçırmaya yol açması ve hedeflenen sonuçtan kaçışın olmaması da aynı erişememe ilişkisine bağlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam, iki şey arasındaki karşılıklı uzaklık veya nitelik ayrılığıyla değil, bir kişinin belli bir şeye yetişip ulaşamamasıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam, yalın erişememe çekirdeği ile ettirgen biçimleri ve belirli söz öbeklerini ayırır; söz öbeklerine özgü sonuçlar yalın anlama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kişinin önüne geçmesi veya ondan uzaklaşması sonucunda kişinin onu kavrayamaması ve ona ulaşamamasıdır. Başkasının buna yol açması ya da kişinin kendisi için belirlenen sonuçtan kaçamaması, bu çekirdeğin bağımlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey kişinin erişebileceği alanın dışına çıkar ve kişi ona yetişip ulaşamaz.
Bir başkası, kişinin o şeye erişememesine veya onu kaçırmasına yol açabilir.
Olumsuz bir kalıpta, kişilerin kendileri için belirlenen sonuçtan öne geçip kaçamayacakları anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı kavrama ve ulaşmanın karşıtı olarak bir şeyin kişiden uzak kalması veya onun önüne geçmesi üzerinde birleştirir. Anlatım hem kişinin bir şeyi kaçırmasını hem de başkasının bu sonucu doğurmasını kapsar; özel olumsuz kullanım ise hedeflenen sonuçtan kaçış bulunmadığını bildirir.
